source_text.body:
Work across Gmail and Google Drive in a shared chat
A user connected Muse to Google Drive and Gmail in a shared chat so it works across those services in ongoing conversations.
·
Oct 10, 2026
Done with
MM
Meta Muse
What they did
In a comment on the thread, one user said they had Muse connected to a shared chat interface alongside Grok and Claude, plus their Google Drive and Gmail. They described the agents passing notes to each other and splitting up different project or research threads, with Muse also using their computer directly for other tasks; the comment does not describe any manual handoff beyond that setup.
How it went
The commenter said the arrangement let Muse work across services in ongoing conversations and coordinate parallel research legs. They gave no metrics, examples from Gmail or Drive specifically, or clear failures for this part of the setup.
Worth knowing
The useful catch is that the source is only a brief Reddit comment, so it confirms the integration at a high level but not the exact steps to reproduce it.
Try it yourself
with
Meta Muse
Copy prompt
I have connected my Gmail and Google Drive. Find [the documents or emails I need, e.g. last quarter's invoices from vendor X] and put the key details into a short summary with links to each source. Stop when the summary is complete. Do not send, share, move, or delete anything without showing me first.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/MetaAI/comments/1x44kpr/two_weeks_into_using_meta_muse_im_asking_how_is
